tvShow.name: Georgie & Mandy's First Marriage
tvShow.overview: Georgie and Mandy raise their young family in Texas while navigating the challenges of adulthood, parenting, and marriage.

episodes.name: The 6:10 to Lubbock
episodes.overview: Georgie and Mandy get fed up living with her parents, the McCallisters.

episodes.name: Some New York Nonsense
episodes.overview: Georgie struggles to balance life, work and family; Mandy worries for Georgie's wellbeing; and Missy gets into trouble at school.

episodes.name: Secrets, Lies and a Chunk of Change
episodes.overview: Georgie digs into Mandy's past when he discovers she's been hiding thousands of dollars of debt. Meanwhile, Mandy tries to right her wrongs by going back to work.

episodes.name: Todd's Mom
episodes.overview: Things get awkward when Georgie and Mandy try to make new friends. Meanwhile, Jim and Audrey get competitive playing a game with Connor. Mandy befriends Beth, a fellow waitress at the diner, who is looking for fun in the wake of her recent divorce.

episodes.name: Thanksgiving
episodes.overview: Mandy struggles to get Georgie's family to join him for his first Thanksgiving without his dad.

episodes.name: A Regular Samaritan
episodes.overview: Georgie joins a church to sell tires to the congregation and Mandy worries there is more to it than that.

episodes.name: An Old Mustang
episodes.overview: Georgie worries that he's leaving Connor out of his new project with Jim. Meanwhile, Mandy and Audrey struggle to decorate CeeCee's nursery without fighting.

episodes.name: Diet Crap
episodes.overview: Tensions rise when Georgie intrudes on Mandy's new sales gig. Meanwhile, Audrey's conflicted when Jim makes it a point not to coddle Connor.

episodes.name: A Tire Convention and the Moral High Ground
episodes.overview: Georgie discovers that Jim's annual tire convention trip isn't what he says it is. Meanwhile, Mandy has doubts about the strength of her and Georgie's marriage.

episodes.name: A House Divided
episodes.overview: Audrey and Mary go to war over CeeCee and Georgie, and Mandy can't help but take sides.

episodes.name: Working for the Enemy
episodes.overview: Audrey's past rears its head when Georgie leaves the tire store to work for Fred Fagenbacher, Jim's longtime nemesis, and Mandy struggles to keep peace in the house.

episodes.name: Typhoid Georgie
episodes.overview: Georgie worries he's letting his family down when he's forced to stay home with a cold, and Mandy worries about how her career will affect her marriage.

episodes.name: McAllister Auto Loves the Ladies
episodes.overview: Jim feels ganged up on when Georgie and Audrey make changes to the tire store, and Mandy helps Georgie navigate a fight between her parents.

episodes.name: A Sportsbook and a Breakup
episodes.overview: Mandy finds out Meemaw runs an illegal sportsbook and decides she wants in on the action. Meanwhile, Georgie struggles to keep Mandy's new job a secret.

episodes.name: Goddess of the Music Store
episodes.overview: Georgie helps Connor impress his new crush, while Mandy, Audrey and Jim struggle to butt out of Connor's love life.

episodes.name: Baby Fight
episodes.overview: Georgie and Mandy worry they're not on the same page when they disagree about having another kid, and Mary, Jim and Audrey struggle to stay out of it.

episodes.name: Two Idiots on a Dirt Bike
episodes.overview: Georgie's attempt to break up Missy and her new boyfriend backfires.

episodes.name: TV Money
episodes.overview: Mandy tries to prove she's financially responsible after Jim and Georgie call out her poor spending habits, and Connor's new girlfriend needs a place to stay.

episodes.name: Snitch v. Deadbeat
episodes.overview: Mandy has to help Meemaw collect money from her dad when he loses some bets, while Georgie tries to intervene between his grandmother and his father-in-law.

episodes.name: Ladies Love Brunch
episodes.overview: Georgie tries to juggle his mom, his mother-in-law and Mandy on Mother's Day. Meanwhile, Audrey wants to meet Connor's girlfriend.

episodes.name: Guilt Boots
episodes.overview: Georgie panics when he learns that Jim is considering selling the tire store to his rival, and Mandy's forced to confront a long-running lie.

episodes.name: Big Decisions
episodes.overview: Tensions rise when Georgie finds out the truth about Mandy's boss, and Georgie does all he can to buy the tire store before Jim sells it.

episodes.name: A Tie Breaker and a Huge Mistake
episodes.overview: Tensions rise in the tire store when new co-owners Georgie and Ruben realize they can't agree on anything, and Jim struggles to find his purpose now that he's retired.

episodes.name: Fan Mail and Old-Timey Organ Music
episodes.overview: Georgie's upset when Mandy's new role as weekend weather girl gets her more attention from the men in town, and Connor turns to Jim for help when he's asked to play the organ at the high school baseball game.

episodes.name: A Will and a Dead Man’s Wife
episodes.overview: Georgie's not ready for his mother to start dating again. Meanwhile, Jim and Audrey struggle to make their wills.

episodes.name: Dirty Hands and a Barbed-Wire Fence
episodes.overview: Georgie and Ruben are forced to get their hands dirty when Fred Fagenbacher tries to run them out of business. Meanwhile, Mandy grows suspicious of Georgie's lies.

episodes.name: A Pregnancy Test and an Old Man’s Prostate
episodes.overview: Georgie's jealousy rears its head when Mandy gets sent on an overnight work trip with her ex and current boss, Scott. Meanwhile, Jim and Audrey panic when they find a pregnancy test in Connor's trash.

episodes.name: Heartbreak and the Refuge of the Downtrodden
episodes.overview: Georgie, Mandy and the family do their best to lift Connor's spirits during a rough patch while Connor tries to figure out a plan for his life.

episodes.name: A Bus Bench and Faith Out the Wazoo
episodes.overview: Audrey and Mary's rivalry resurfaces as Georgie seeks their help at the tire store, while Jim faces aging concerns after going to the DMV.

episodes.name: Bitin', Spankin' and a Load of Yankee Psychobabble
episodes.overview: Georgie and Mandy get upset when Audrey disciplines CeeCee without their permission.

episodes.name: Payback and a Partial Shebang
episodes.overview: Georgie's feud with a rival store threatens his partnership with Ruben. Meanwhile, Mandy finds out Georgie's been keeping secrets from her.

episodes.name: Miami Beach and a Magical Family Christmas
episodes.overview: Georgie and Mandy struggle to balance work, family and the holidays when Audrey plans an unexpected Christmas vacation.

episodes.name: A New Hobby, a Pervert and a Part-Time Job
episodes.overview: Audrey and Mandy urge Jim to find a new hobby now that he's retired and driving them crazy.

episodes.name: The G Word and a Blaspheming Bimbo
episodes.overview: Mandy makes a controversial remark on live TV that puts her job, Georgie's business and the family's reputation at risk.

episodes.name: A Big Birthday and Tequila Shots
episodes.overview: Mandy struggles to celebrate Georgie’s 21st birthday after hitting a rough patch in her career.

episodes.name: Three Angry Women and a Prophylactic
episodes.overview: Mandy's attempt to help Missy with boys backfires when Mary finds out and Georgie is caught in the crossfire.

episodes.name: A Stuffed Monkey and an Ex-Girlfriend
episodes.overview: When CeeCee loses her favorite toy, Mandy and Meemaw take it as an opportunity to make some money. Meanwhile, Connor contemplates revisiting an old relationship.

episodes.name: Alpha Males and the Power of Prayer
episodes.overview: Mandy tries to make things right with Pastor Jeff when she learns her controversial comments have hurt the tire store's business. Meanwhile, Jim and Audrey butt heads over Connor's allowance.

episodes.name: A Country Club, a Yokel and a New Boss
episodes.overview: Georgie's plan to make new clients at the local country club backfires when its outdated policies upset Audrey. Meanwhile, Mandy struggles to prove herself at work.

episodes.name: A New Scoreboard and a Horse's You-Know-What
episodes.overview: Georgie and Fagenbacher go head to head when Fagenbacher tries to sabotage Georgie's attempt to honor his dad.

episodes.name: A Little Schmoozin' and a Nose for the News
episodes.overview: Georgie's plan to get on the news sparks a feud between Mandy and a rival weathergirl. Meanwhile, Mandy tries to use the conflict to help her career.

episodes.name: Splurges and Secrets
episodes.overview: A financial windfall leads Georgie to make a questionable purchase; Audrey and Jim butt heads over old secrets.

episodes.name: Funky Chili and Friends Who Take Their Clothes Off
episodes.overview: Mandy and Jim butt heads when they take over the store for a sick Georgie and Ruben. Meanwhile, Audrey panics when Connor rekindles an old flame.

episodes.name: A New Beau and Someone Else's Mom's House
episodes.overview: Georgie and Mandy take matters into their own hands when Mary starts warming up to Fagenbacher. Also, Audrey struggles to cope with Connor’s absence.

seasons.overview: Georgie and Fagenbacher go head to head when Fagenbacher tries to sabotage Georgie's attempt to honor his dad.

Georgie y Mandy - Su primer matrimonio

reviews.author: Matthew Dykstra
reviews.content:
For a show that is part of *The Big Bang Theory* universe, *Georgie & Mandy’s First Marriage* is turning into something really special. Georgie has proven he can hold his own as a lead character, especially alongside Mandy, and Season 2 has done a great job blending the Cooper and McAllister families.

What I really like is that the show does not feel like it belongs only to Georgie’s side or Mandy’s side. It feels like a true mix of both families. Keeping regular appearances from Mary, Missy, Pastor Jeff, Meemaw, and Dale helps keep the series grounded in the *Young Sheldon* and *Big Bang Theory* universe, while Jim, Audrey, Connor, and an older CeCe make sure Mandy’s family remains just as important.

I would still love to see Sheldon appear at least once, maybe while he is home from college for reading week or holiday break. It would be a fun connection without making the show too dependent on him.

Honestly, this series also makes me want another show set in this same timeline, focused on Sheldon’s college years before *The Big Bang Theory* begins. We only get a small glimpse of that period in *The Big Bang Theory* Season 3, Episode 22, “The Staircase Implementation,” when Leonard moves in, the elevator breaks, and the Roommate Agreement begins. There is definitely more story that could be explored there.

Overall, *Georgie & Mandy’s First Marriage* works because it respects the larger universe while still building its own identity.
